title: Confinement as Integrity Collapse: A Contract-Frozen Structural Signature of Quark Binding in the GCD/UMCP Measurement Kernel
main_question: What structural signature does the quark->hadron boundary leave when quarks and hadrons are evaluated under a single frozen source-local particle-data closure?
open_burdens: Independent reconstruction under the mature architecture with current source data/version, a frozen particle/hadron adapter, stable channel semantics across compared object classes, the current kernel contract, explicit missingness, sensitivity/ablation tests, and comparison against native-domain explanations and alternative adapters.
